description: For any finite list of colourings of fixed positive-size subsets of the naturals, each using finitely many positive-numbered colours, one infinite set is homogeneous for all the colourings; their colours may differ.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.simultaneous_infinite_ramsey (r : ℕ) (n k : Fin r → ℕ)
  (hn : ∀ (j : Fin r), 0 < n j) (hk : ∀ (j : Fin r), 0 < k j)
  (c : (j : Fin r) → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.Coloring ℕ (n j) (Fin (k j))) :
  ∃ H, H.Infinite ∧ ∀ (j : Fin r), Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneous (c j) H
